# MCP tools

Tools registered by the Basics MCP server. Call them over stdio (`basics-mcp`) or HTTP (`basics ui`).

## `list_layers`

List the stack layers (backend, frontend, testing, ...) and the technologies stored under each.

No inputs.

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "list_layers",
  "arguments": {}
}
```

## `search_vault`

Full-text search over the user's stack vault. Use before proposing new notes to avoid duplicates.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | — |
| `type` | `layer` \| `tech` \| `practice` \| `check` \| `profile` \| `project` | no | — |
| `layer` | `string` | no | Restrict to tech notes in this layer |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | — |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "search_vault",
  "arguments": {
    "query": "rest api"
  }
}
```

## `get_note`

Read a vault note (frontmatter + markdown body) plus which notes link to it.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | — |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "get_note",
  "arguments": {
    "id": "fastapi"
  }
}
```

## `recommend_stack`

Given a natural-language project description, return ranked technology candidates per layer and matching stack profiles from the user's vault. Treat as a shortlist: read the candidate notes, choose, and explain the choice to the user. Prefer the user's vault over general knowledge.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `string` | yes | — |
| `layers` | `string`[] | no | — |
| `per_layer` | `integer` | no | — |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "recommend_stack",
  "arguments": {
    "description": "example"
  }
}
```

## `get_stack_context`

Compile best practices and validation checks for a chosen set of technologies into one markdown document. Call once the stack is chosen and follow it while writing code; run the listed checks before declaring work done.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tech_ids` | `string`[] | yes | — |
| `versions` | map<string, `string`> | no | — |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "get_stack_context",
  "arguments": {
    "tech_ids": [
      "example"
    ]
  }
}
```

## `get_check_templates`

Return the file templates (tests, configs) shipped by the checks of a chosen stack. Write missing files into the project; never overwrite existing files.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | `string`[] | yes | — |
| `versions` | map<string, `string`> | no | — |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "get_check_templates",
  "arguments": {
    "stack": [
      "example"
    ]
  }
}
```

## `detect_stack`

Detect technologies and versions from a project directory's package.json, pyproject.toml and requirements files. Read-only.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Existing project directory |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "detect_stack",
  "arguments": {
    "path": "./project"
  }
}
```

## `propose_note`

Propose a new note or an update to an existing one. It lands in the vault inbox for the user to approve; it is NOT applied directly. Frontmatter must match the note type schema (e.g. tech: kind, layer, use_when, avoid_when, performs_best, practices, checks). Use [[id]] wikilinks in the body to connect notes.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Slug, e.g. 'fastapi' or 'react-server-components' |
| `type` | `layer` \| `tech` \| `practice` \| `check` \| `profile` \| `project` | yes | — |
| `frontmatter` | map<string, unknown> | yes | Fields for the note type, excluding 'type' |
| `body` | `string` | yes | Markdown body |
| `reason` | `string` | yes | Why this note should be added/changed |
| `agent` | `string` | yes | Name of the proposing agent, e.g. 'claude-code' |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "propose_note",
  "arguments": {
    "id": "fastapi",
    "type": "layer",
    "frontmatter": {},
    "body": "example",
    "reason": "example",
    "agent": "claude-code"
  }
}
```

## `record_project_outcome`

Propose an outcome for a project note: append lessons, optionally extend tech notes (use_when, avoid_when, performs_best, lessons) and add a dated outcome section. Everything lands in the vault inbox for review; nothing is applied directly.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `string` | yes | Project note id |
| `summary` | `string` | yes | What happened and what was learned |
| `lessons` | `string`[] | no | — |
| `tech_updates` | { id, add_use_when, add_avoid_when, add_performs_best, lesson }[] | no | — |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "record_project_outcome",
  "arguments": {
    "project": "fastapi",
    "summary": "example"
  }
}
```

## `export_project`

Render the files that make a project's coding agents follow the user's stack: STACK.md always, plus AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and/or Cursor rules. Pass the current file contents in `existing` so agent-file blocks merge instead of overwriting user text; basics never writes outside the vault.

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | `string`[] | yes | — |
| `targets` | `agents` \| `claude` \| `cursor`[] | no | — |
| `existing` | map<string, `string`> | no | Current file contents keyed by relative path |

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "export_project",
  "arguments": {
    "stack": [
      "example"
    ]
  }
}
```

## `list_proposals`

List agent proposals waiting for user review in the vault inbox.

No inputs.

Minimal call:

```json
{
  "name": "list_proposals",
  "arguments": {}
}
```
